## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag needs to take its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, because the project's CLI-flag policy requires this for every new flag under `cli/`. Apart from that, the exclusion logic and its tests behave as the PR description says.

## Changes
Adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option. `collect()` uses it to skip any file whose basename matches one of the patterns, logging each skipped path. The PR also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds parser, collection, end-to-end archive tests and a text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the `--exclude` default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — CI setting `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` has no effect, because the flag's default is hard-coded as `default=[]`. That breaks the policy rule "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable" (`.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs that set options through the environment cannot exclude files and will archive content they meant to skip. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")` split on a documented separator, update the "none" default in `docs/flags.md:7`, and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover the environment variable.
